forms: Fresh declared routine-local exact INTEGER scalars, fields, ARRAY leaves and captured named/grouped USING aliases
identity: Capture selector once; retain the actual live defining frame and exact timer record independently of retained handler frame lists
lifetime: Pause/nested calls retain connections; explicit disconnect or exact-frame unwind releases them on normal/early return, failure, stop, abort, budget and generator close
handlers: Live defining frames permit timer control from captured handlers; returned frames retain readable frozen data but cannot reconnect or disconnect scoped timers
cleanup: Remove only exact owned records; reject changed/lost scoped registrations before clock/value updates; preserve caller and sibling connections
counters: Conservative lexical whole-root exclusion within the defining routine; fresh locals in other routines and global roots with the same spelling are separate for timer interference
linkage: Linked/concurrent invocations retain independent local frames; existing global/private timer invocation lifetimes remain separate
persistence: No local values, frames, ownership bindings, live clocks or suspended execution in context JSON
boundary: Borrowed formal timer roots, non-INTEGER/config/readonly domains, inferred alias ownership, native timing and public strict mode remain unsupported
